support.otherApps.title: Other Apps We've Created
support.faq.gettingStarted.q1: What is Smart Upload and how does it work?
support.faq.gettingStarted.a1: Smart Upload automatically syncs product images from Google Drive to your Shopify store. By matching image filenames to your product SKUs, Barcodes, or Titles, you can upload hundreds of images in bulk.
support.faq.gettingStarted.q2: How do I connect my storage service?
support.faq.gettingStarted.a2: To get started, click on 'New Upload' from the Dashboard. You will be prompted to connect your Google Drive account so the app can securely access your image folders.
support.faq.gettingStarted.q3: How should I name my image files?
support.faq.gettingStarted.a3: For the best accuracy, name your image files exactly matching your product SKUs or Barcodes. For example, if your SKU is 'SHIRT-001', name your image 'SHIRT-001.jpg' or 'SHIRT-001.png'.
support.faq.uploadsSync.title: Uploads & Syncing
support.faq.uploadsSync.q1: Can I preview images before they are uploaded?
support.faq.uploadsSync.a1: Yes! After selecting your folder and matching strategy, the app will show you a preview of all matched images. No changes will be made to your store until you confirm and start the upload.
support.faq.uploadsSync.q2: What happens if an image doesn't match a product?
support.faq.uploadsSync.a2: Unmatched images will simply be skipped. You can review any unmatched files during the preview step, allowing you to correct the filenames in your storage folder and refresh the upload.
support.faq.plansBilling.title: Plans & Billing
support.faq.plansBilling.q1: What is included in the Premium plan?
support.faq.plansBilling.a1: The Premium plan unlocks unlimited bulk image uploads, advanced filtering, bulk deletion tools, and priority background processing to ensure your images sync as fast as possible.
support.faq.plansBilling.q2: Does the premium plan have a free trial?
support.faq.plansBilling.a2: Yes, we offer a free trial so you can test out the automated syncing and advanced matching features before committing.
